failures.message: names nothing the suite ran at head — Every column `PRAGMA table_info(tasks)` reports at head is declared in `tests/test_ledger.py`, either with one production function that names it in code or as a carve-out with a non-empty reason. The guard reports a column declared in neither. It also reports a column whose reader is `Ledger.__init__`, `Ledger._apply` or `Ledger._touch_task`, sits under `saffron/record/`, or never names the column in code. A docstring or a comment that names it does not count. `merged_head_sha`'s reader is `reconcile` in `saffron/reconcile.py`. The witness adds an unread column, and the guard names it. It then declares as a reader, in turn, each of the three write paths, one function under `saffron/record/`, one function that never names its column, and one that names it only in its docstring. The guard names that column each time.
